tagline: A community marketplace powered by Apps Hub profiles.
description: Publish classified listings with photos, descriptions, categories, prices or free items. Browse a public catalog and manage your own listings with your existing Apps Hub account. Desktop settings control categories, subcategories and listing validity.
capabilities: Public catalog with search, category and price filters.
Apps Hub accounts own and manage their listings.
Up to ten photos per listing.
Free items, location and optional public contact details.
Edit, activate, deactivate and delete personal listings.
Automatic expiry and reactivation of expired listings.
Bump an active listing once every 24 hours.
Desktop category, subcategory and validity settings.
Private conversations linked to listings, with unread counts and Apps Hub identities.
Per-listing currencies matching Regional Settings, with currency-specific price filters.
